suite: UV arrival hold + continuous fade: production WebGL pixels

cases.name: DPR1: Landing stays opaque and at target while successor keeps moving
DPR1: Hold has exactly the opaque reference colour, not an arbitrary flash
DPR1: Hold lasts .8 wall seconds with no progress changes
DPR1: Early fade has no abrupt material recolour
DPR1: True mid-fade GPU pixel differs from both endpoints
DPR1: Fade reaches identical legacy background pixels
DPR1: Fade changes no pose, selection, camera or timing
DPR1: Labels ease with surface instead of snapping
DPR1: Strict sequential boundary never flashes all waiting islands solid
DPR1: Pause restores the previous display immediately and cancels all tails
DPR1: Reverse and loop wrap clear the previous forward arrival
DPR1: Natural completion restores rather than adding a full-queue delay
DPR1: Geometry replacement clears old timers and stale IDs
DPR1: Several fast arrivals have independent opacity without a two-tail cap
DPR1: No shader, Javascript or WebGL errors
